title: Charles of Egmond, BnF fr. 3015 no. 8

steps.what: Web tool failed to open Gallica; direct HTTP retrieved the IIIF manifest and BnF catalogue successfully.
Catalogue places no. 8 at folio 16. Retrieved and visually inspected Gallica views 27 (letter) and 28 (ciphered address). Downloaded 3000-pixel body image for transcription.
Made a provisional shape-label transcription of the first three body lines. Similar cross, zigzag and loop forms remain unresolved; not a diplomatic transcription.

Initial probe failed because numba and ducroc/frn5.npy were absent. Replaced it with NumPy and the existing 24-symbol period-French model gallica_sweep/mondoucet/f1573/fr5.npy. Corrected an initial model-dimension mismatch.

Many-to-one substitution collapsed to repeated letters under the conditional language model. Switched to a bijective 24-letter permutation; 12 seeds at 40000 proposals each on separate/dd/ee/both segmentation variants did not produce readable French. This does not rule out substitution because transcription and token boundaries are provisional.

Retrieved and inspected Gallica views 39–40, the separate folio 24 clear letter and address. Confirmed grand-maitre address and 3 April 1537 date as context only, not a clear-copy match to cipher item 8.
Constructed a French monoalphabetic positive control of comparable length; the same probe recovered every plaintext letter exactly. Control is synthetic, not the target plaintext.
Reversing the provisional three-line transcription yielded no readable French under the same model. Does not exclude systems or readings under a corrected transcription.
Built an indexed contact sheet and bounding boxes of first-line ink components for glyph comparison; component count is not a token count.
Tested separating provisional ee pairs into c-like and e-like forms. The global replacement did not yield readable French; occurrence-level checking remains necessary.
Independently transcribed the address using shape descriptions: provisional 56 tokens/20 labels, measured with _check_profile.py. An overlapping ascender/descender is not an additional token.
Opening revision 2 separates plus/4, top-bar/side-bar and c/e-like forms; measured provisional 175 tokens and 21 labels. Original document counts remain unknown.

German and Italian probes on the original opening, French probes on revised opening and independent address, and compound-stroke variants all lacked a coherent reading. Scores not calibrated across languages.

French/Dutch/German searches located Kalsbeek 1932 as a bibliographic lead but no digitized copy. Inspected Docquier chapter on Maximilian/Margaret correspondence: contextual Guelders discussion, no target shelfmark or cipher mention in extracted text.

Extended provisional body transcript to six lines: 343 tokens and 22 labels measured by _check_profile.py; added glyph legend and source crops. W newly distinguished, so earlier lines require consistent rechecking.
Tested paired-D and paired-D/CE null hypotheses on opening and six-line draft; no sustained readable output. Shortened scores are not direct evidence for null status.

Tested many-to-one French substitution on six-line compound-stroke variant, penalizing divergence from average model next-letter distribution. Produced fragments but no coherent or verified reading; no plaintext accepted.
Extended provisional transcript to sixteen main lines: 804 draft labels, 23 distinct; insertion omitted.
Full-text compound and null variants produced sustained French fragments; prior short probes failed.

Saved reproducible inferred key and uncorrected candidate French reading. Provisional address grand maistre de France cross-check supports nulls; full image audit, insertion and date remain unresolved.

Re-inspected address and body lines 1,2,3,9,13,14,16 against source crops. Saved explicit shape-token corrections and replay script, retaining unexplained spellings. Address reads A mon bon cousin / Monsieur le grant maistre / de France; nine body lines and insertion still need audit. This is image/key consistency, not an independent plaintext control.

Audited remaining main lines; resolved guerre, commander of Saint John, and Arnhem. Read raised entenderes on line 7 and newly identified sa on line 15. Native 4351 x 6122 scan obtained via curl after Python access failures.
Saved full candidate diplomatic reading and English sense translation in READING.md, preserving anomalous spellings. Date dih[u]itieme de iuillet interpreted as 18 July with M blotted u; year absent.
Standard checker measures corrected body plus both insertions at 726 signs, 27 draft labels; aliases prevent treating the latter as historical alphabet size.
Targeted searches on the newly read titles and apparent date found no matching edition or confirmed year; no external plaintext used.

Native-image review distinguishes the left-extending bar in lextreme from plain plus/g. It still has only one occurrence, so x remains M. Native crops confirm the anomalous literal forms; no silent emendation. All main lines, both insertions, address and clear closing accounted for.

Prior solution found after reading: G. Lasry pointed out that he solved this cipher in 2023 (key on cryptiana GL.htm section 2). The prior-work search had missed it. The reading here is an independent re-solution; not yet compared sign by sign with his key.

Lasry review (email 25 Sept 2026): not a first break (Lasry 2023, key on cryptiana GL.htm), so it is dropped from the ciphertext-only list sent to Klaus Schmeh; method unchanged, marked independent re-solution on the site.

outcome.method_basis: The graphic substitution of BnF fr. 3015 no. 8 was broken from a new transcription of the Gallica images by language-model annealing with compound-stroke and null variants, then audited line by line; independent re-solution: Lasry had solved it in 2023 (cryptiana GL.htm section 2), found only afterwards.
outcome.notes: Every transcribed sign has a proposed letter or null value; this is coverage, not 100% confidence. Left-bar x and blotted date u remain M; anomalous literal spellings retained. Internal body/address consistency only, no independent key or clear copy.

prior.where: G. Lasry's key (2023) on S. Tomokiyo's cryptiana, GL.htm section 2; plaintext not published

human: User supplied target and Gallica link and reminded the model of the existing private DECODE cookie.
